base_model_licence_source: read from the model card and repository at revision 58a29f6d on 2026-10-10; see base_model_licences.json
training_set_description: en_corpus with its prose-judgement items replaced (not shipped)
loss: answer tokens only; prompt tokens masked with -100; EOS appended to every pair

boundary_checks.concessions_note: retired on the offsets path: the span check is exact and needs neither the leading-whitespace nor the truncation-tail concession

seed_note: the seed was set before the adapter was built, so it governs initialisation, data order and dropout
adapter_sha256_definition: sha256 of adapter_model.safetensors alone, the whole file
adapter_sha256_source: written by the trainer at train time and published in the repository's manifests/ folder; re-hashed locally and matching
adapter_expect_digest_definition: sha256 over the concatenated contents of adapter_config.json and the adapter weights (adapter_model.safetensors, or adapter_model.bin) in sorted filename order, first 16 hex characters; any other file beside them, such as a training manifest, is not part of the digest
reading_link_note: the weights hash is recorded in this training manifest, and the per-cell reading files taken through this adapter record the same adapter digest; the aggregated records that the results database ingests carry the run label only, so within the database the link from those readings to these weights rests on the label, which maps to this manifest alone
